products.title: MUSK 07 EDP + BODY LOTION GIFT SET
products.body_html:
Musk 07 Deep, sensual musks are layered with a luxurious burst of mouth-watering fruits as
pomegranate and blackcurrant add their notes of juicy opulence. The sweet berries melt
deliciously into a captivating bouquet of floral notes, as roses and lily of the valley take centre stage. The musks team with patchouli for an alluring finish that leaves a memorable signature in your wake.

Gift Set Includes: 

Musk 07 Extrait de Parfum - 50ml 

Musk 07 Body Lotion - 300ml
